name: ActivitySignature
author: Alex Hedström

sections.description:
Activity Signature helps administrators monitor account activity. It records when users are created, updated, log in, fail to log in, change roles, or are deleted — then surfaces that data in a dashboard and activity log under Settings.

Features

  • User overview dashboard with search, role, login-status, date, and never-logged-in filters
  • Chronological activity log with type and date filters
  • Actor attribution and expandable event details
  • Failed login tracking with rate limiting
  • Failed-login summaries and optional threshold email alerts
  • Last Login column on the Users screen
  • Optional WooCommerce Orders column and order filters on the Dashboard
  • Filtered CSV export, bulk deletion, and activity log purge
  • Configurable retention and items per page
  • Per-event tracking controls with role and user exclusions
  • Operational diagnostics for records, scheduled cleanup, and a manual cleanup run
  • WordPress personal data export, erasure, and privacy-policy integration
  • About tab for Activity Signature context
sections.installation:
1. Upload the activitysignature folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen
  3. Go to Settings → Activity Signature
sections.faq:
Where is the admin screen?

Settings → Activity Signature. Tabs: Dashboard, Activity Log, Settings, About.

What personal data does this plugin store?

Activity records stay on your WordPress site in a custom table. They may include usernames, email addresses, IP addresses, the account that performed an action, and event dates. Nothing is sent to the plugin author or a third-party service. Set how long rows are kept under Settings → Activity Signature → Settings. The plugin registers with WordPress Tools → Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data, and adds suggested text under Settings → Privacy.

Does retention delete last-login values?

No. Retention only prunes historical activity log rows. Last-login and last-update user meta are kept.

Does the WooCommerce integration require WooCommerce?

Yes. Enable it under Settings → Integrations. The Orders column and order filters only appear when WooCommerce is installed and active.
